description: Client-side script for Payment Reconciliation form in ERPNext, defining a controller class with methods for form interactions, data fetching, and reconciliation logic.

classes.name: PaymentReconciliationController
classes.description: Controller class managing payment reconciliation form behavior, including data loading, validation, and reconciliation processes.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Initializes form fields, sets default values, and configures query filters on form load.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Disables save, sets read-only properties, and adds custom buttons based on form state.

methods.name: company
methods.description: Resets party and account fields when company changes.

methods.name: party_type
methods.description: Resets party field when party type changes.

methods.name: party
methods.description: Fetches and sets the party's receivable/payable account if not already set.

methods.name: receivable_payable_account
methods.description: Clears child tables when account changes.

methods.name: clear_child_tables
methods.description: Clears invoices, payments, and allocation tables.

methods.name: get_unreconciled_entries
methods.description: Fetches unreconciled invoices and payments, with validation and error messages.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates selected invoices and payments, then refreshes the form.

methods.name: reconcile
methods.description: Handles reconciliation, including showing a dialog for difference accounts if needed.

methods.name: reconcile_payment_entries
methods.description: Performs the reconciliation process and clears allocation table.
